      else if (!(((state.taStatus != "confirmed") && (state.taStatus != "rejected")))) Left(iMadzError("TA_TERMINAL_CONFLICT", "TA_TERMINAL_CONFLICT"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTAConfirmed/TA_SHARE_FUND@1904035b9107bb90
      else if (!(((((p.shares).fundCode == state.fundCode) && (((p.shares).shares).value).nonEmpty) && (((p.shares).nav).value).nonEmpty))) Left(iMadzError("TA_SHARE_FUND", "TA_SHARE_FUND"))

    }

  final class RecordFundTARejectedRule(hosts: FundOrderComputations)
      extends InvariantRule[Event, State, RecordFundTARejectedParams] {
    override def apply(state: State, p: RecordFundTARejectedParams): Either[iMadzError, List[Event]] = {
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTARejected/TA_ORDER@8f7cfe2aac5249c1

      else if (!(((p.paymentTxId == state.selectedPaymentTxId) && ((state.cashPaymentFinalResults).get(p.paymentTxId)).contains("succeeded")))) Left(iMadzError("TA_PAYMENT", "TA_PAYMENT"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTARejected/TA_REQUEST@0d2e741cbb2fb100
      else if (!(((p.taRequestId == state.taRequestId) && ((p.taRequestId).value).nonEmpty))) Left(iMadzError("TA_REQUEST", "TA_REQUEST"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTARejected/TA_REFERENCE@3aeeecfe7c21e6da

      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTARejected/TA_FUND@b61df0aed6a95c6b
      else if (!(((p.fundCode == state.fundCode) && (p.currency == (state.amount).currency)))) Left(iMadzError("TA_FUND", "TA_FUND"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTARejected/TA_RECEIPT_PRESENT@37c8818d11c7bb2c

      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTARejected/TA_RECEIPT_CONFLICT@0766eab6711ef65a

      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTARejected/TA_RECEIPT_ONCE@4cd1f67ea0e37b97
      else if (((state.taReceipts).contains(p.receiptId))) Right(Nil)
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTARejected/TA_TERMINAL_CONFLICT@d3763e61c367509d
      else if (!(((state.taStatus != "confirmed") && (state.taStatus != "rejected")))) Left(iMadzError("TA_TERMINAL_CONFLICT", "TA_TERMINAL_CONFLICT"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordFundTARejected/TA_REJECTION_REASON@4da4fff23abca765

  final class RecordCashRequestSourceRule(hosts: FundOrderComputations)
      extends InvariantRule[Event, State, RecordCashRequestSourceParams] {
    override def apply(state: State, p: RecordCashRequestSourceParams): Either[iMadzError, List[Event]] = {
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_OPTION@8d5cd42c66dae2cd
      if (!((p.source).contains(p.original))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_OPTION", "CASH_SOURCE_OPTION"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_RESOURCE@e43393ec335bca0c
      else if (!(((p.original).fundOrderId == state.id))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_RESOURCE", "CASH_SOURCE_RESOURCE"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_BODY@971346caf9b36c72
      else if (!(((((((((p.original).principalId).nonEmpty && ((p.original).clientRequestId).nonEmpty) && ((p.original).authorityVersion).nonEmpty) && (((p.original).operationId).value).nonEmpty) && ((p.original).fundCode).nonEmpty) && (((p.original).amount).currency == "CNY")) && (((p.original).amount).amount > BigDecimal("0.00"))))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_BODY", "CASH_SOURCE_BODY"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_CONFLICT@9249ddb91600e58b
      else if (!(((state.cashRequestSource).isEmpty || (state.cashRequestSource).contains(p.original)))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_CONFLICT", "CASH_SOURCE_CONFLICT"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_PAYMENT@ac741fcb3660199f
      else if (!(((state.status == "new") || ((((((p.original).operationId == state.operationId) && ((p.original).investorAccountId == state.investorAccountId)) && ((p.original).fundCollectionAccountId == state.fundCollectionAccountId)) && ((p.original).fundCode == state.fundCode)) && ((((p.original).amount).currency == (state.amount).currency) && (((p.original).amount).amount == (state.amount).amount)))))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_PAYMENT", "CASH_SOURCE_PAYMENT"))
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_ONCE@4e2ce655112ab1cf
      else if (!((state.cashRequestSource).isEmpty)) Right(Nil)
      // @knowledge bank-wealth/bankwealth/guard/FundOrder/RecordCashRequestSource/CASH_SOURCE_BEFORE_SETTLEMENT@74823ab61e4a8f86
      else if (!((state.status == "new"))) Left(iMadzError("CASH_SOURCE_BEFORE_SETTLEMENT", "CASH_SOURCE_BEFORE_SETTLEMENT"))
      else Right(List(CashRequestSourceRecorded(p.original, p.source)))
    }
  }
